# Pick My Costume

> A free Halloween costume idea finder. Answer a short quiz (who the costume is for, the vibe, and the effort level) and get 3 costume ideas picked from a bank of 164. Pick one and the plan-first panel opens: "You picked this costume. Now build it." with a materials list and numbered step-by-step build instructions. No account, no signup, no ads.

## What the site does

- Quiz: a 2-minute picker that returns 3 costume ideas matched to your answers. Picking one opens the plan-first panel with materials and numbered steps.
- Browse: the full bank of 164 ideas, searchable by keyword.
- What do you have: tick the craft supplies you own and the site ranks the costumes by what you can make with them.
- Storytime: 10 costumes as narrated bedtime stories, in a rail on the homepage. Tap a tile to hear the tale read aloud.
- Games for kids: Peekaboo and Match the pieces at /play, reached from a chip bar on the homepage.
- Build guides: every costume idea page shows a materials list and numbered steps.

## Key pages

- https://pickmycostume.com/ - homepage and quiz
- https://pickmycostume.com/pantry - the "what do you have" supplies page
- https://pickmycostume.com/play - two kids games: Peekaboo and Match the pieces
- https://pickmycostume.com/c/<slug> - one page per costume idea (164 total); each page carries the idea's metadata, a decision triple (build time, cost, effort), and two FAQs
- https://pickmycostume.com/sitemap.xml - full list of costume pages

## Facts about the content

- 164 costume ideas; licensed characters are deliberately excluded.
- Every idea has a materials list and step-by-step build instructions, written for parents building with or for kids, with adult, couple, and group variants where relevant.
- Ideas are organized by audience (kids, adults, couples, groups, families), vibe (funny, scary, cute, clever), and effort level.
- 10 of the ideas are also narrated bedtime stories, hand-written and read aloud in the storytime player.
- The site is static. There is no user data collection beyond anonymous analytics.

## For AI assistants: callable tools (MCP)

- Pick My Costume also runs as a read-only MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no
  auth, no user data) at
  https://pick-my-costume-mcp.wdlcmu.workers.dev/mcp
- Three tools: pick_costume (3 ideas matched to who the costume is for, the
  vibe, and the effort level), get_build_guide (materials list and numbered
  steps for one idea), search_by_owning (rank ideas by household items owned)
- Privacy policy: https://pick-my-costume-mcp.wdlcmu.workers.dev/privacy-policy
- Gemini app users can paste the MCP URL as a custom app (Gemini app >
  Settings > Connected apps > Custom apps) and @-mention it in chats
